recommendation.rationale: These gifts let Astrid explore music in playful ways, from typing melodies on a bright keyboard to adding festive jingles to her tunes. The storybook and rhythm game encourage imagination and cooperative play while building her sense of beat.

wish.text: Dear Astrid, at eight years old you already fill the workshop with bright curiosity and joy. I’ve left a touch of rainbow-colored music, sparkling jingles, a storybook where you can write your own songs, and a playful rhythm adventure to discover. Merry Christmas!
